issues.description: Field 'Book.title' has a type mismatch: the problem statement (problem_statement.md) specifies that a Book consists of two Strings 'title' and 'author', but the reference solution declares the 'title' property as an Int. This contradicts the solution's usage sites (e.g. in Sources/BookstoreLib/Client.swift where Book instances are initialized with String literals for title) and will cause compilation errors and confusion for students implementing the exercise.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the type of the 'title' property in the Book struct to String (e.g. 'let title: String') so it matches the problem statement and the places where Book values are constructed and printed. Ensure any affected code (initializers or usages) remains consistent with the String type.
